basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old environmental enthusiast currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I've recently joined Reddit to explore more about sustainable living and waste management. I work as a junior analyst in a renewable energy startup and am passionate about making a difference in the world. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the beautiful Oregon trails and experimenting with vegan recipes. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science and have been actively volunteering in various environmental and community service initiatives. My knowledge primarily comes from academic studies and hands-on experience in sustainability projects.
